title: Artifact Registry: where the image lives before it runs

videos.script: Every compute product in this course runs an image from somewhere. On Google Cloud, that somewhere is Artifact Registry. {{repositories}} First, the address. Region, project, repository, image and tag, read left to right like a path. The region in it decides what a pull costs. {{pushing}} Then the push. gcloud becomes Docker's credential helper, and no password is ever stored. A registry on your laptop speaks the same protocol, and you will push the shop's web image to it. {{tags}} Then the part that bites. A tag is a pointer, and you will watch latest move to different bytes while its name stays the same. The digest never moves. {{scanning}} Last, scanning. What a scan can tell you about an image, and the three things it cannot.
